gold: Syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum in situ (SCACPIS) arising in a precursor lesion of syringocystadenoma papilliferum (SCAP) with macular amyloidosis

selector.rationale: Hidradenoma papilliferum best explains the findings due to its characteristic histopathological features of a circumscribed tumor with apocrine epithelial lining, papillary projections, and the presence of atypical cells without dermal invasion, which aligns with the provided vignette and histopathological examination results.

rejected.label: Syringocystadenoma papilliferum
rejected.why: Lack of strong supportive evidence and distinctive features in the vignette

rejected.label: Apocrine gland carcinoma
rejected.why: Presence of atypical cells and areas of necrosis but no dermal invasion does not strongly support carcinoma

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: Congophilic amorphous eosinophilic deposits in dermal papillae are noted but not a primary feature of the lesion
